question: What will the official BCRA wholesale USD/ARS reference exchange rate (dólar mayorista, Comunicación A 3500) be on October 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Spot wholesale closed 1524.50 on Oct 19 (Ámbito), up from 1518 Friday; October range ~1503-1525. MATBA-Rofex October dollar future ~1527-1534 (settles Oct 30, one business day after the target date), so median ~1530. Country risk hit 2026 high (~660-676bp) and The City fears contagion to the dollar -> mild upside skew; offset by heavy BCRA buying ($642M in 4 sessions) and rate far from band ceiling (~1925). 8 business days remain; no plausible mechanism to exit 1400-1750. No Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found; futures are the only market anchor.

- Oct 15 mayorista ~1504 bid/1513 offer; Oct 13 ~1503.5/1512.5 (lanoticia1). Oct 5: 1520, 26.6% below band ceiling 1924.62, widest gap of the year; September moved only 0.6% (A24, 2026-10-05).
- Early Oct futures implied ~1540 end-Oct and ~1597 December (A24, Oct 5). Around Oct 19, the MATBA-Rofex October contract (DLRV2026) was quoted ~1527, with another report of ~1534 for end-October (TradingView/iProfesional search snippets).
- Country risk ~660-676bp on Oct 19, highest of 2026; ADRs down up to 6%; weaker growth data, higher wholesale inflation, 2027 election tension; City fears contagion to the dollar (La Nación, iProfesional, Ámbito, Oct 19).
- BCRA bought $642M over the last 4 sessions; YTD purchases ~$14.6-14.7bn; reserves >$48bn (Ámbito, A24).
- Band floor ~720, ceiling ~1925-1930; rate floats freely inside.
- Status quo: little movement over 8 business days; October so far ~1503-1525.
- Resolves off the BCRA Com. A 3500 reference rate for Oct 29 (a weighted average), not the close or BNA retail; it can differ from the close by a few pesos.
- Event window: single fixing on Oct 29, 2026; as of Oct 19, 8 business days remain.
- Searched for Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold markets on this: none found. Could not fetch the BCRA dashboard series directly (page showed no values).
